A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TAR3D study, with readable text, equations, tables and figures. V2 includes supplementary Sections A–B and Figures 8–10; inspection of the complete v3 establishes their omission rather than an extraction gap.

before.justification: V2 reports original conditional 3D-generation experiments and ablations in Section 4, Tables 1–4 and Figures 4–7, with additional generated examples in the supplement.

after.justification: V3 retains the original experimental comparisons and ablations in Section 4, Tables 1–4 and Figures 4–7.

M1.justification: The VQ-VAE/GPT architecture, plane-information interaction, TriPE, sequence ordering, conditioning and training objectives remain unchanged. Removing the future plan for a unified codebook does not change the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions use ShapeNet and Objaverse for conditional 3D generation and GSO for out-of-domain evaluation. The omitted galleries illustrate retained coverage. ABO and OmniObject3D, mentioned only as future data sources in v2, were not evaluated datasets.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Shap-E, SyncDreamer, Michelangelo, InstantMesh and LGM. Comparator membership in Figures 4–5 also matches across versions. Newly cited methods in related work are not added to the reported experiments.

E3.justification: The reported splits, preprocessing, model configurations and training budgets are unchanged. Both retain evaluation using 20 rendered views at 224×224, 16K surface points and an F-Score threshold of 0.02. No replacement protocol accompanies the omitted supplementary examples.

E4.justification: V3 removes Appendix A's illustrated case of object-faithful generation despite incidental caption content, exemplified by the camera prompt mentioning a grey background in Figure 10. The VQ-VAE, plane-interaction, TriPE and triplane-size ablations remain unchanged, as does the main GSO comparison.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The single-value reporting practice in Tables 1–4 is unchanged.

E6.justification: V3 removes the additional image-conditioned and text-conditioned mesh results in Figures 8–10. All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and the retained qualitative comparisons are unchanged; for example, TAR3D's Table 1 Chamfer Distance remains 0.066 and F-Score remains 0.303.

T1.justification: The quantization definition, autoregressive factorization and loss formulations in Equations 1–6 retain the same mathematics. The added punctuation after Equation 1 is cosmetic. Neither supplement contains additional theoretical proofs or propositions.

C1.justification: The abstract and introductory contributions retain the same claims about triplane quantization, plane-information interaction, TriPE and superior conditional 3D generation. V3 deletes a repeated performance summary from the conclusion without withdrawing that claim elsewhere.

C2.justification: V3 drops the supplementary discussion of unsatisfactory ULIP render quality, noisy captions and sequences three times the length of image-autoregressive sequences. It also removes the unified-tokenization future direction and the interpretation of noisy-caption examples. Main result interpretations and brief scaling/sequence-efficiency plans remain.

D1.justification: Both versions provide the same homepage link and implementation information, including hyperparameters, optimizers, training steps and eight-A100 training hardware. The removed re-rendering and Cap3D-captioning suggestions were future plans, not procedures used in the reported experiments.

R1.justification: V3 expands existing citation lists with works including AR-1-to-3 and 3DTopia-XL, while removing entries including DDPM, MiniGPT-4, Cap3D, ABO and OmniObject3D. The broad positioning against diffusion-based generation and mesh-face autoregression remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The main sections remain largely verbatim and in the same order. V3 deletes supplementary Sections A–B, shortens the conclusion and future work, revises affiliations, adds an acknowledgment and makes localized wording and punctuation edits.

P2.justification: V3 removes all three full-page supplementary galleries, Figures 8–10, substantially reducing the multi-panel visual presentation. References become a continuous block following the main text. Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–4 retain their designs and displayed content.

improvement.justification: V3 preserves the method, quantitative findings and main ablations, but removes supplementary multi-view generation evidence and explicit disclosures about prompt noise and data-quality limitations. The localized editorial and citation updates do not offset this loss of supporting evidence and transparency. The decline is limited because the central scientific contribution and its primary evaluation remain intact.
